subject: Follow-up on the Predictive Maintenance contract
body:
Hi Jonas!! Just checking in on the contract :) Any news on your side? We are super excited to get started and can jump on a call whenever works!

Cheers,
Sam

subject: Follow-up: Predictive Maintenance contract, reference KEW-2026-014
body:
Dear Mr Weller,

Further to the contract sent on 5 November, may I ask whether your legal team has any open questions? The open action on your side is the countersignature; I will call you on Thursday to follow up. This email can be forwarded to your colleagues as it stands.

Kind regards,
Sam Keller
Service Delivery Lead, Beta Industrial Services

subject: Contract
body: Jonas, sign the contract. We need it this week. Do not make me chase you again.

subject: Follow-up on the Predictive Maintenance contract
body:
Dear Mr Weller,

I hope this message finds you well, and I am very sorry to trouble you again, and I know how busy you are, and I wanted to say that if there is anything at all that we could do to make this easier then please just let us know, and also that we have been thinking a lot about your plant and the many things that matter to you, and in this context I wondered whether, perhaps, you had had a moment to look at the contract we sent, though of course there is no rush whatsoever.

Best wishes,
Sam
